hints: The product of everything except position `i` splits into two independent halves. What are they?
It is the product of everything to the left of `i` times the product of everything to its right. Neither half depends on `readings[i]`.
Sweep left to right storing the running product of everything before each position, then sweep right to left multiplying in the running product of everything after it.
Use the output list itself to hold the left-hand products during the first sweep; the second sweep only needs one extra variable.
